Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR aligns desktop Details row heights, text, icons, headings, separators, and trailing controls. **Example:** Viewing desktop Details in Chromium at 1440×1500. - **Before:** Single-line rows range from 24 to 32 px, with text starting at different horizontal positions. - **After:** Single-line rows use 30 px heights and share a panel-relative text axis at x=41. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | The visual change is supported by direct screenshot proof and passing UI shards, with no actionable source finding; unresolved E2E attribution limits merge confidence. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected dark and light before-and-after browser screenshots of the real Details components using the session-design fixture in Chromium at 1440×1500; they demonstrate the changed alignment, typography, separators, and controls, and the subsequent commit leaves production CSS unchanged. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Preference · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Desktop Details sections have inconsistent row heights, text axes, typography, and control alignment. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction supplies the owner decision, and the inspected screenshots show a coherent improvement within the existing desktop styling boundary. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep this maintainer-authored PR open. The earlier geometry finding is fixed, the CSS-budget overage is explicitly accepted, and no introduced defect remains established; separate E2E failures still need attribution. **Priority:** P3 **Reviewed head:** `ab194a11daeb59c7f1f1cc2c083718b5fabace15` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The desktop Details composition styles existing session section renderers, turning session data into People, Environment, pull request, process, output, progress, and automation rows. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Session data] --> B[Existing section renderers] B --> C[Desktop Details body] D[Desktop composition CSS] --> C E[Shared leaf styles] --> C C --> F[Visible Details panel] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep desktop composition CSS as the layout owner and retain the browser checks through its actual scroll container. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main CSS establishes the differing section metrics, and the supplied before screenshots show their visible effects; no local runtime reproduction was run. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Desktop-scoped CSS uses the existing presentation owner, and the test adjustment preserves useful behavioral checks without freezing the former visual dimensions. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [2fe0a234f29b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2fe0a234f29b8b0d42e9fa6a274720aaaba77745). ### Provenance checked - `Desktop row metrics, heading geometry, and icon placement` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (33b16c7ef875e94b387f61a78fdb4942333e45ac: Organize compact, readable Details sections while retaining native renderers and accessible actions.) - `Compact task-progress typography` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (ce1fd810bba5c767abcc5521130444286665011e: Keep saved progress available through a compact checklist with separate desktop and mobile presentation.) - `Task marker and wrapped-description alignment` keeps the original intent (6160b254974cfaa1d1e5ddbad69c1961bd5b21b7: Align status markers with the first text line and connect steps without changing progress state or interactions.) - `Branch-row readability and publication controls` keeps the original intent (01b890d9c6409c5c4f5886f054a25f738a67574b: Keep branch identity with Environment and place diff counts and publication actions below it while preserving the publication owner.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Introduced change and current main:** The pinned introduced diff contains desktop styling changes and a browser-test adjustment; fetched main retains the previous row metrics and typography. ([`ui/src/styles/chat/details-desktop.css:20`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ab194a11daeb59c7f1f1cc2c083718b5fabace15/ui/src/styles/chat/details-desktop.css#L20), [ab194a11daeb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ab194a11daeb59c7f1f1cc2c083718b5fabace15)) - **Earlier geometry finding resolved:** The test now mounts ChatDetailsDesktopBody with its actual content gutters, checks overflow at the scroll owner, and retains alignment, clipping, non-overlap, keyboard, publication, and dismissal assertions. All three current-head checks-ui shards passed. ([`ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-pull-requests.browser.test.tsx:171`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ab194a11daeb59c7f1f1cc2c083718b5fabace15/ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-pull-requests.browser.test.tsx#L171), [ab194a11daeb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ab194a11daeb59c7f1f1cc2c083718b5fabace15)) - **Accepted CSS-budget tradeoff:** The maintainer-authored PR body explicitly accepts the CSS-budget overage and waives no other PR-caused failing check. Current-head performance annotations report total CSS raw and gzip growth, matching that accepted tradeoff. ([`ui/src/styles/chat/details-desktop.css:551`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ab194a11daeb59c7f1f1cc2c083718b5fabace15/ui/src/styles/chat/details-desktop.css#L551), [ab194a11daeb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ab194a11daeb59c7f1f1cc2c083718b5fabace15)) - **Inspected visual proof:** Inspected the four prepared dark/light before-and-after screenshots linked in the PR body; they show the changed desktop alignment, progress typography, separators, and trailing glyph positions using the session-design browser fixture. ([ab194a11daeb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ab194a11daeb59c7f1f1cc2c083718b5fabace15)) - **Feature history and preserved contracts:** Reviewed the compact Details direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176424, saved progress presentation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176406, first-line marker alignment in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182716, and branch readability in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171995. Scoped history also followed the browser test's earlier .ts name. ([`ui/src/styles/chat/task-progress-details.css:271`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/2fe0a234f29b8b0d42e9fa6a274720aaaba77745/ui/src/styles/chat/task-progress-details.css#L271), [2fe0a234f29b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2fe0a234f29b8b0d42e9fa6a274720aaaba77745)) - **Remaining CI attribution:** Current-head E2E annotations report a mobile sidebar menu width mismatch and an unexpected cloud placement badge: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41227297186/job/124614317772 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41227297186/job/124614317764. Inspection does not establish either failure as diff-caused or inherited, so no author repair is assigned. Full job-log downloads were blocked by the network allowlist; annotations remained readable. ([`ui/src/e2e/sidebar-session-stability.e2e.test.ts:119`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ab194a11daeb59c7f1f1cc2c083718b5fabace15/ui/src/e2e/sidebar-session-stability.e2e.test.ts#L119), [ab194a11daeb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ab194a11daeb59c7f1f1cc2c083718b5fabace15)) Likely related people: - **Vyctor H. This identifies author metadata, not feature responsibility or a PR merger. ### Labels Label changes: - add `rating: 🐚 platinum hermit`: Overall readiness is 🐚 platinum hermit; proof is 🦞 diamond lobster and patch quality is 🐚 platinum hermit. - add `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: ClawSweeper has no concrete contributor-facing blocker left for this PR. - remove `rating: 🦪 silver shellfish`: Current PR rating is `rating: 🐚 platinum hermit`, so this older rating label is no longer current. - remove `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: Current PR status label is `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`. Label justifications: - `P3`: This is desktop visual consistency work without a demonstrated broken core workflow. - `rating: 🐚 platinum hermit`: Overall readiness is 🐚 platinum hermit; proof is 🦞 diamond lobster and patch quality is 🐚 platinum hermit. - `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: ClawSweeper has no concrete contributor-facing blocker left for this PR. - `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. - `proof: 📸 screenshot`: Contributor real behavior proof includes screenshot evidence. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab. Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality; ✨ marks media proof (a screenshot, video, or linked artifact) that directly shows the changed behavior. ### Workflow ClawSweeper edits this one comment on every review.
